name: scvelo
description: scVelo is a third-party RNA velocity tool primitive for inferring trajectory direction, latent time, and driver genes from spliced and unspliced single-cell counts. Use it after Scanpy preprocessing when a directional trajectory model is needed.
capabilities: Estimate RNA velocity from spliced and unspliced layers in AnnData.
Compute velocity graphs, latent time, and velocity confidence scores.
Expose stochastic and dynamical model paths for different analysis budgets.
Add directional trajectory evidence to Scanpy embeddings and cluster labels.
requirements: Python environment with scvelo, scanpy, and anndata installed.
Spliced and unspliced layers in AnnData.
Neighbors or UMAP available for visualization; dynamical fits may be memory intensive.
